condition_selection_rule: all input_condition_specified conditions not proved wholly outside fixed domain; keep fixed/unsupported conditions in capability census and all admitted branch targets in denominator
holdout_rule: dtype-only decisions are held out of feedback-policy tuning; source/oracle qualification controls are allowed but excluded from effect results
seed_derivation: coverage-universe-v1-formal-master-seed-index, first32bits SHA256, indices0..7; independent of control successes
A: same per-target skeleton schedule as B; uniform legal input/action choice without predicate filtering; same identification and observation
B: fixed target quotas and master-seeded skeleton schedule independent of predicate satisfiability; alternating desired true/false input condition, fixed random tie breaks; impossible/unknown/target-absent retained
C: same candidate actions and no-feedback baseline as B; verified feedback may prioritize outcomes/regions/normalized contexts within target; cannot add actions or change target quota
AB_pairing: compare on shared DAG skeleton prefix, also report full wall-budget results separately; different input choices allowed, graph identities must match at each paired ordinal
BC_pairing: matched master seeds, generation distribution,target quotas and full budgets; choices may diverge after verified feedback; record that divergence
cost_accounting: wall starts at arm process launch, including import,graph generation,all failed proposals,binding,queue,inputs,eager,compile,observation,serialization and timeout cleanup; charge each arm its generation cost, no free pregenerated control corpus
cache_policy: identical flags, empty per-arm/seed Inductor,Triton and CUDA cache dirs; forced source compilation, no cross-arm cache reuse; Python imports also charged
primary_results: fixed642 target outcomes hit on legal-input compilation attempts,globally deduplicated
same hits restricted to successful execution
public operator kinds actually at backend entry /55 reported separately
secondary_results: BF16 support rejections retained separately from bugs
hypotheses: B-A improvement in predeclared source branch coverage
C-B improvement in same source branch coverage

analysis.replicate_unit: master seed, not request or kernel
analysis.primary_effect: per-seed paired covered-outcome count difference; proportions use common642 denominator
analysis.stability_test: two-sided exact sign test over nonzero master-seed differences, Holm correction for two primary comparisons
analysis.uncertainty: paired master-seed bootstrap95% interval for mean difference,10000resamples with fixed analysis seed
analysis.positive_claim_requires: positive mean difference,bootstrap lower bound>0,Holm-adjusted sign-test p<0.05; operator-kind improvement requires separate evidence and is never inferred from branch improvement
analysis.no_optional_stopping: complete all8masterseeds unless protocol invalidated; do not add seeds or discard hard cases to obtain positivity

required_runner_gates: common A/B/C action-set and predicted-goal fairness check
real post-feedback selections on supported and heldout conditions
universe membership and excluded-edge/domain falsification check for each source report
wall deadline and child cleanup checks
invalidation: stop inference and issue a new protocol/data version on metric/domain/fairness failure, even mid-run; preserve raw failures and costs; negative or inconclusive effect alone never invalidates a protocol
